subject: [PATCH] mm/khugepaged: free unused page table when setting a huge PMD fails

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Identified a potential issue with concurrent userfaultfd operations and suggested tracking whether do_set_pmd() allocated the table to free it after dropping the PMD lock. Proposed changes to do_set_pmd() to preserve any preallocated table supplied by the caller for PTE fallback.

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau
reviews.summary: Agreed with David's suggestion and proposed an alternative solution to free the unused page table in set_huge_pmd() if it was allocated by do_set_pmd().

2026-11-05.patch_summary: Free unused page table allocated by do_set_pmd() when setting a huge PMD fails, to prevent loss of the preallocated table in concurrent userfaultfd operations.
